purpose: Teach: 演歌/林檎/車庫/国宝/大西洋/スリル/毛皮/ビーフ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが演歌を口ずさんでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa's been humming enka to himself.
lines.style: Soft, noticing tone. Gentle half-smile in the voice. Speaking aloud a small observation, the kind you share when you're comfortable in a room together. Warm, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの林檎ジャム大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandma's apple jam.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Earnest and unselfconscious. The particular enthusiasm of a child sharing something he's been thinking about. Quick, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと車庫でキャンプ用品の整理しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, shall we help your dad organize the camping gear in the garage?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not directive. Warm invitation — offering something to do together, a reason to move. Soft and practical, the tone of someone already thinking of the next thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、博物館で国宝の刀を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw this incredible sword at the museum — it was a national treasure.
lines.style: Open and animated. The words tumble a little because he's excited to share. Direct, unselfconscious. The cadence of a child who has something cool to tell you.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔、大西洋を渡られたんですって
lines.en: Sho, did you know your dad actually crossed the Atlantic when he was younger?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Offering up a small fact about his father — something Sho might not have known. Warm admiration underneath. Quiet, conversational.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お化け屋敷のスリルにドキドキしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the haunted house was so scary — my heart wouldn't stop pounding.
lines.style: Alive with the memory of it. The thrill still fresh in his voice. Quick-paced on the excitement, then a slight settle on the physical sensation. Open, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが毛皮のショールを着てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma looked so elegant in that fur shawl.
lines.style: Observant, appreciative. The tone of someone who notices and wants to hold a small, beautiful detail. Soft focus. Gentle admiration, not performative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママのビーフシチュー大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I love Mum's beef stew so much.
lines.style: Warm, contented. The voice of a child settling into comfort. Simple and complete — not seeking approval, just sharing something he knows is good. Close, intimate.
